name: Synera AI Agents
description: Multi-agent autonomous engineering AI built on top of Synera's low-code engineering platform that executes, iterates, and coordinates approvals across 75+ CAx/PLM tools. Marketed as 'autonomous AI engineers' that automate RFQ generation, FE analysis, additive manufacturing build prep, and injection molding workflows.

name: Synera Platform (formerly ELISE)
description: Visual-editor low-code engineering platform that automates parametric workflows across 75+ CAx and PLM tools (BMW, Hyundai, Airbus, NASA, Safran). Originally launched as ELISE in 2018 in Bremen; rebranded Synera and joined the Altair Partner Alliance.

name: Synera + Materialise Magics SDK Integration
description: Joint integration that streamlines additive-manufacturing build preparation by exposing Materialise Magics SDK functions to Synera's AI agents. Lets engineers automate orientation, support, and slicing decisions inside an agentic workflow.

name: nTop 5 Implicit Modeling Kernel
description: Major release (June 2024) of nTop's proprietary implicit-modeling geometry kernel powering field-driven design, lattice generation, and physics-aware lightweighting for advanced manufacturing. Replaces traditional B-rep with continuous mathematical fields that drive geometry from simulation results.

name: nTop Field Optimization
description: Generative-design module released in nTop 4 that uses field-driven workflows to optimize complex DfAM parameter spaces (lattices, medical implants, lightweighting). Couples implicit modeling with embedded FEA to generate higher-performing AM parts.

name: nTop + Lockheed Martin AI Embedded Simulation
description: Customer case study showing nTop's embedded simulation paired with AI surrogates accelerating Lockheed Martin's design cycles for aerospace structures. Cited by nTop as a flagship deployment of implicit + ML-surrogate workflows.

name: Hyperganic Core
description: Algorithmic-engineering platform built on a voxel/implicit geometry kernel that lets engineers encode design knowledge as code to generate parts at print-resolution. Powers Hyperganic's AM workflows for aerospace propulsion (with EOS), medical, and energy.

name: Hyperganic Meshless Simulation
description: Meshless physics simulation that operates directly on the implicit geometry, removing the meshing bottleneck inside the algorithmic design loop. Enabled by Hyperganic's acquisition of DirectFEM.

name: Diabatix ColdStream
description: Cloud-based generative thermal-design platform that explores cooling concepts (pins, fins, gyroids) and returns topology-optimized cold plates, heat sinks, manifolds and heat exchangers tied to specific manufacturing processes (3DP, die casting, CNC, sheet metal). Reports up to +60% heat-transfer-efficiency gains on copper heatsinks.

name: ToffeeX
description: Cloud-native generative-design tool combining implicit modeling with physics-driven optimization for cooling components (cold plates, heat exchangers, heat sinks, manifolds, data-center cooling). Customers include Airbus, Rolls-Royce, EOS, Toyota, GE, Baker Hughes.

name: Augmenta Electrical
description: Spatial-AI building-design product that auto-generates fully coordinated 3D electrical models (conduit routing, clash-free coordination) for datacenters and large buildings in hours instead of weeks. Currently the only shipping module of Augmenta's MEP platform; Mechanical and Plumbing announced as 'coming soon'.

name: Neural Concept Intelligence Platform
description: Physics-AI platform that trains geometric deep-learning surrogates from historical CAE data and integrates with NX, CATIA, SolidWorks, Fluent, and Abaqus for aerodynamics, thermal, and structural prediction. Replaces 'Neural Concept Shape' messaging with broader 'Intelligence platform' branding in 2024.

name: PhysicsX Platform
description: Enterprise physics-AI platform for AI-driven multiphysics inference, numerical simulation, data management, and agentic deployment. Public partnerships with Siemens (data-center power), NVIDIA (Physics-AI standards), CoreWeave, and Microsoft Discovery.

name: ARENA Physica Atlas RF Studio
description: Beta electromagnetic simulation product from ARENA Physica positioning itself as 'electromagnetic superintelligence' for RF/EM design. ARENA-AI rebranded to arenaphysica.com and refocused on EM AI in 2025.

name: Autodesk Project Bernini
description: Foundation generative-AI model for 3D shape creation announced by Autodesk Research in 2024. Trained on millions of 3D shapes; intended as a building block for downstream Fusion / Forma generative-CAD experiences.

name: Autodesk WaLa (Wavelet Latent Diffusion)
description: Billion-parameter 3D generative model that compresses shapes via wavelet latent diffusion for high-resolution generation. Released in 2024 as part of Autodesk Research's neural-CAD push.

name: Autodesk BrepGen
description: Diffusion model that natively generates Boundary-Representation (B-rep) CAD geometry with structured latent geometry, instead of meshes. First-class B-rep generator for parametric-CAD workflows.

name: Autodesk Make-A-Shape
description: Ten-million-scale 3D shape generative model trained on the largest publicly described 3D dataset for shape generation. Companion to Bernini and WaLa in Autodesk Research's 3D foundation-model lineup.

name: Autodesk CadVLM
description: End-to-end vision-language model for parametric CAD generation - first multimodal LLM successfully applied to producing parametric (sketch+extrude-style) CAD operations. Co-led by Karl Willis.

name: Autodesk Image-to-CAD
description: Research feature converting an image, sketch, or drawing directly into a B-rep CAD model in one step. Demonstrated by Karl Willis at CDFAM 2024 alongside BrepGen.

name: Autodesk Engineering Design Benchmark Suite
description: Public benchmark suite (co-led by Daniele Grandi) for evaluating LLMs on engineering-design tasks: interpreting requirements, material selection, and product-recall risk assessment. Designed to expose design biases and accelerate dataset publication.
organization: Autodesk Research + MIT + UC Berkeley + CMU

name: Celedon Solutions Davinci
description: Hardware-IDE copilot for SysML v2 model-based systems engineering: chat-driven requirements/parts/interface trees, integrated Python+simulation, MCP tool integration, and one-click validation/fixes. Pitched for CubeSat, drone, cybersecurity, and nuclear-electric-propulsion concepts.

name: Onshape AI Advisor
description: Conversational AI assistant inside Onshape that answers product/best-practice questions and guides users through Onshape commands. Listed under 'More than CAD' in the Onshape product nav.

name: Adam (AI CAD Copilot)
description: Browser-based AI CAD startup that turns natural-language prompts into parametric, manufacturable 3D models, founded by UC Berkeley M.Des grads Zach Dive (CEO) and Aaron Li (CPO). Viral consumer demo (10M+ social impressions) raised a $4.1M seed in Oct 2025; pivoting to a pro CAD copilot starting with Onshape integration.

name: Backflip 3D Mesh-to-CAD
description: AI tool that converts 3D scan/mesh data into parametric CAD models with one click; native Onshape integration and STEP export for downstream manufacturing. Marketed at the 'frontend of the 3D design process'.

name: Altair Inspire (post-Siemens)
description: CAE-for-designers tool that bundles topology optimization, PolyNURBS organic modeling, lattice/implicit design, GPU-accelerated CFD, and DfM virtual tests into a CAD-like environment. Now part of Siemens Xcelerator following the 2024 Altair acquisition.

name: Altair PhysicsAI
description: AI surrogate platform that learns geometric deep-learning models from historical CAE data and predicts physical behavior up to 1000x faster than solvers. Shipped via HyperWorks; 2025 release added Transformer Neural Simulator (TNS) alongside the original Graph Context Neural Simulator (GCNS).

name: CATIA xGenerative Design
description: Cloud (3DEXPERIENCE) generative-modeling app combining graphical visual scripting with interactive 3D modeling for algorithmic and bio-inspired shapes. R2026x adds a new AI operator that generates 3D mesh from images.

name: CATIA Aura (Virtual Companion)
description: Cloud-based 3DEXPERIENCE CATIA chatbot copilot that gives in-context LLM guidance and best-practice answers. Introduced in CATIA R2026x along with browser-version CATIA.

name: CATIA Command Intelligence
description: AI feature in CATIA that anticipates the user's next likely action and surfaces command suggestions; Dassault reports ~30% design-time speedup.

name: CATIA Mechanical Interface Prediction
description: AI-driven assembly assistant that analyzes surfaces and parts to auto-generate interface-based connections, accelerating large-assembly authoring in CATIA.

name: Siemens NX Design Copilot
description: Natural-language interface inside NX/NX X that translates plain-English queries into NX commands, surfaces design best practices, and helps with error resolution. Launched in the NX Summer 2025 release.

name: Siemens NX CAM Copilot
description: AI copilot for CNC machining inside NX X Manufacturing that proposes 3+ machining strategies for a given feature; cited up to 80% reduction in CAM programming time. GA in the NX 2512 December 2025 release after a 2025 beta.

name: PTC Creo Generative Design (ex-Frustum)
description: Generative-design and topology-optimization modules built from Frustum's IP after PTC's $70M acquisition (Nov 2018). Couples Creo with ANSYS Discovery Live for live physics-validated generative design.

name: ParaMatters CogniCAD 5.0
description: Cloud generative-design and topology-optimization platform with automated FEA, ML-based supports generation, AM print simulation, and STEP/STL output. Originally launched at CES 2018; major versions 2.0 (2019), 3.0 (2019), and 5.0 (2022).

name: Promethean AI World Building
description: Natural-language scene-creation tool that auto-imports/tags asset libraries and places furniture, props, lighting, and environment assets contextually. Native Unity/Unreal Engine integration; first publicly unveiled November 2018.

name: Krea 3D
description: Image-to-3D and text-to-3D generation built into Krea's creative suite, using Hunyuan3D, Trellis, and Tripo backends. Exports to Blender/Unity for downstream use; targets product-photo turntables, AR/VR props, and scene generation.

name: Spline AI 3D Generation
description: Text-to-3D and image-to-3D generation inside Spline's collaborative web 3D editor; produces 4 variants per prompt and supports remixing. Alpha launched March 30, 2023; full Spline platform beta March 10, 2022.

name: CALA (Fashion OS)
description: First fashion 'operating system' to integrate OpenAI DALL-E (Jan 2023): users pick from 25 base styles (sweater, blouse, tote, etc.) then iterate via two text prompts (design + trims) to generate apparel/accessory illustrations linked to the supply chain. Founded 2016; AI module launched January 2023.

name: Sloyd
description: AI 3D-model generator for text-to-3D and image-to-3D with auto-rigging/animation; plugins for Unity, Unreal, Blender. Targets game devs, designers, and 3D-printing prosumers.

name: McClelland - Generative Design and Digital Manufacturing (SPIE 2022)
description: SPIE paper introducing NASA Goddard's 'Evolved Structures' process: AI-driven generative design + cloud computing + digital manufacturing applied to spaceflight optical instruments. Reports >10x reduction in development time/cost and >3x improvement in mass/stiffness/strength.

name: McClelland - Evolved Structures: Using AI and Robots (AI Summit 2023)
description: NASA AI Summit 2023 presentation by Ryan McClelland summarizing 'evolved structures' adoption across 8+ NASA missions (EXCITE balloon telescope, Mars Sample Return capture-lid mechanism, etc.) and the generative-design + 3D-printing workflow used to build them.

name: NASA Goddard Evolved Structures Capability
description: Goddard Engineering & Technology Directorate capability page for the Evolved Structures program: combines generative design and digital manufacturing to automate spacecraft/instrument structure development, claiming ~3x performance and ~10x time/cost gains.

name: AI Bones - Evolved Structures for Future Exploration
description: Goddard ETD 'AI Bones' program page describing generatively-designed mission hardware that resembles bone-like organic geometry, weighs less, tolerates more stress, and ships in a fraction of the typical part-development time.

name: Pierson et al. - Structural Optimization of Turbomachinery Rotors via ML Surrogates (NASA GRC, 2025)
description: NASA GRC paper benchmarking Random Forest and 1-5-layer MLP surrogates (scikit-learn) on 500-5000 LHS samples for turbomachinery rotor optimization; couples surrogate models with differential evolution and validates with FEA.

name: Hearley - Materials Informatics at NASA GRC (2024)
description: NASA GRC overview of cyberinfrastructure for ICME: multiscale physics-based material models, surrogate-ML models, materials information management, and digital-thread automation aligned to NASA Vision 2040.

name: Stuckner - Materials Informatics at GRC (2023)
description: NASA GRC presentation by Joshua Stuckner on materials-informatics infrastructure, ML surrogate modeling, and integrated toolsets supporting digital-thread workflows for aerospace materials.

name: Arnold/Mital/Hearley - ML Stiffness & Fatigue for Polymer Composites (2023)
description: NASA paper using MLP and RNN architectures to predict initial stiffness and fatigue life of 8-ply symmetric polymer-matrix composite laminates; RNN better captures fatigue curve patterns. Surrogate is intended for system-level design and multiscale analyses.

name: NASA Cislunar Trajectory Design with NN Sizing (IAC 2024)
description: Cislunar trajectory-design study (IAC-24-C1.7.4.83115) using neural-network surrogates for maneuver design; identifies a 6_100_50_30_0_3 NN topology as the most appropriate for cislunar spacecraft maneuvers.

name: NASA TM-20240006865 - Evidence for Learning-Enabled Aerospace Components (2024)
description: NASA Technical Memorandum giving recommendations on certifying neural-network and ML components in aerospace systems: model generalization, robustness verification, and feed-forward NN testing methodologies.

name: NASA SciTech 2024 - NN Surrogates for Turbofan Fan Blades (Pierson)
description: NASA SciTech 2024 paper using neural-network surrogates as a response-surface for turbofan fan-blade design; notably leverages ChatGPT in the design-system construction.

name: Buehler - X-LoRA (Mixture of LoRA Experts for Materials)
description: Mixture-of-LoRA-experts framework with deep layer-wise dynamic gating that mixes adapter experts (biology, chemistry, physics, mechanics, protein analysis) at the token+layer level. Applied to protein mechanics and design (APL Machine Learning, 2024).

name: Buehler - BioinspiredLLM
description: Open-source autoregressive LLM specialized on the mechanics of biological and bio-inspired materials, designed as a conversational interface for biomimetic materials engineering. Published in Advanced Science (2024).

name: Buehler - Multi-Agent Generative AI for Molecular Design (2025)
description: Multi-agent generative-AI system for molecular analysis and design, coordinating specialized agents to propose, simulate, and refine candidate molecules. Linked from Buehler's 2025 Washington Award announcement.

name: McComb - Human+AI Design Initiative (CMU)
description: Director-level CMU initiative led by Chris McComb on human-AI teaming for engineering design: research has 'evolved from proving collaboration was possible to engineering robust systems integrating AI agents, workflows, and validation methods into design practice.' Showcased at SXSW 2025.

name: Bits to Atoms (Substack by Duann Scott / CDFAM)
description: Editorial home of the CDFAM Computational Design Symposium Series; weekly Substack covering computational design, AI/ML for engineering and architecture, and interviews with practitioners (incl. McClelland, Willis, McComb, Buehler).

name: Karl Willis - LinkedIn post: ICML 2023 generative-CAD work
description: Karl D.D. Willis LinkedIn post (Jul 2023, post id 7090028254891315200) summarizing Autodesk's ICML 2023 contributions on generative AI for CAD - precursor to BrepGen and CadVLM.

name: Ryan McClelland - LinkedIn: 'Evolved Structures' Podcast Ep. 92 (2022)
description: McClelland LinkedIn post (Sep 2022, activity 6973275659389313024) sharing the 'Evolved Structures' podcast episode 92 covering NASA Goddard's generative-design + 3D-printing program for spacecraft structures.

name: Markus Buehler - X/Twitter: MIT Predictive Multiscale Materials Design Short Course
description: Buehler X post (status 1907411567991279759) announcing the MIT Predictive Multiscale Materials Design Short Course - hands-on training that bundles multiscale modeling, generative AI, and materials informatics.

name: Daniele Grandi - Autodesk Research blog: 'Intelligence at the Intersection of Design, Make, Physical World'
description: Grandi blog post outlining Autodesk Research's view of AI models that 'understand physical reality' - a roadmap from generative 3D shape models toward design AI agents that respect manufacturability and physics constraints.

name: NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo (formerly Modulus)
description: NVIDIA's open-source physics-ML framework rebranded from Modulus to PhysicsNeMo. Provides recipes for FNO, neural operators, GNN surrogates, and digital-twin workflows; v25.08 (Aug 2025) added new CAE workflows.

name: Synopsys.ai Copilot (genAI for chip design)
description: Synopsys.ai Copilot brings generative AI to EDA workflows for semiconductor design - knowledge assistance, RTL generation, and verification helpers. Expanded with new genAI capabilities in 2024-2025.

name: Autodesk Blank.AI (acquired)
description: Autodesk acquisition (2024) bringing generative-AI conceptual-design capabilities for the automotive industry into Fusion: real-time creation, exploration, and editing of 3D vehicle/product concepts.
